# 1 Chronicles Chapter 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 385r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_029_page_001.jpg

---

**29:1** And-said David the-king to-all the-assembly [ha-qahal]: Shelomoh my-son — one [echad] chose in-him God — [is] young [na'ar] and-tender [rakh], and-the-work [ha-melakhah] [is] great [gedolah], for not for-man [lo le-adam] the-fortress [ha-birah] but for-YHWH God [elohim].

**29:2** And-with-all my-strength [u-ve-khol kochi] I-have-prepared [hakhiynotiy] for-the-house of-my-God — the-gold for-the-[things of]-gold, and-the-silver for-the-silver, and-the-bronze for-the-bronze, the-iron for-the-iron, and-the-wood for-the-wood; stones of-onyx [avney shoham] and-[stones of]-settings [millu'im], stones of-antimony [pukhh] and-embroidery [riqmah], and-every precious stone [even yeqarah], and-stones of-marble [avney shayish] in-abundance [la-rov].

**29:3** And-moreover [ve-od], in-my-delight [bir'tsotiy] in-the-house of-my-God, there-is-to-me a-treasure [segullah] — gold and-silver — I-give [natatiy] to-the-house of-my-God, above and-beyond [le-ma'lah] all I-have-prepared for-the-house of-the-sanctuary [beyt ha-qodesh]: **29:4** three-thousand talents [kikkerey] of-gold, of-the-gold of-Ofir, and-seven-thousand talents of-silver refined [mezuqqaq], to-overlay [la-tur] the-walls of-the-houses [qirot ha-battim]; **29:5** the-gold for-the-gold, and-the-silver for-the-silver, and-for-all the-work by-the-hand of-the-craftsmen [charashim]. And-who [is] volunteering [mitnaddeb] to-fill [le-malle] his-hand [yado] to-YHWH today [ha-yom]?

**29:6** And-volunteered [vayyitnaddevu] the-officers [sarey] of-the-fathers and-the-officers of-the-tribes of-Yisra'el, and-the-commanders of-the-thousands and-the-hundreds, and-the-officers of-the-work of-the-king [melekhet ha-melekh]. **29:7** And-they-gave for-the-service of-the-house of-God [ha-elohim]: gold — five-thousand talents [kikkarim] and-ten-thousand darics [adarkonim]; and-silver — ten-thousand talents; and-bronze — eighteen-thousand talents; and-iron — one-hundred-thousand talents. **29:8** And-everyone who-was-found with-him precious-stones [avanim] gave to-the-treasury [le-otsar] of-the-house of-YHWH, upon the-hand of-Yechi'el the-Gershunni.

**29:9** And-rejoiced [vayyism'chu] the-people over their-volunteering [al hitnaddvam], for with-a-whole heart [be-lev shalem] they-volunteered [hitnaddvu] to-YHWH. And-also David the-king rejoiced [samach] a-great [gedolah] joy [simchah].

**29:10** And-blessed [vayvarekhh] David YHWH before-the-eyes-of [le-eyney] all the-assembly [ha-qahal], and-said David: Blessed [barukh] [are] you, YHWH, God of-Yisra'el our-father [avinu], from-everlasting [me-olam] and-unto everlasting [ve-ad olam].

**29:11** To-you, YHWH, [is] the-greatness [ha-gedulah] and-the-might [ve-ha-gevurah] and-the-beauty [ve-ha-tif'eret] and-the-victory [ve-ha-netsach] and-the-majesty [ve-ha-hod], for all [kol] in-the-heavens and-in-the-earth [ba-shamayim u-va-arets] — to-you, YHWH, [is] the-kingdom [ha-mamlakhah], and-the-one-lifting-himself [ve-ha-mitnasse] as-head [le-rosh] over-all.

**29:12** And-the-riches [ve-ha-osher] and-the-honor [ve-ha-kavod] [are] from-before-you [millefaneykha], and-you [are] ruling [moshel] over-all, and-in-your-hand [u-ve-yadekha] [is] strength [koach] and-might [u-gevurah], and-in-your-hand [u-ve-yadekha] to-make-great [le-gaddel] and-to-give-strength [u-le-chazzeq] to-all.

**29:13** And-now, our-God, we [are] giving-thanks [modim] to-you and-praising [u-mehallelim] the-name of-your-beauty [shem tif'artekhha].

**29:14** And-but who [am] I, and-who [are] my-people, that-we-should-retain-strength [ki na'atsor koach] to-volunteer [le-hitnaddeb] like-this [ka-zot]? For from-you [ki mimm'kha] [is] the-all [ha-kol], and-from-your-hand [u-mi-yadekha] we-have-given [natannu] to-you.

**29:15** For sojourners [gerim] [are] we before-you [lefaneykha] and-temporary-residents [ve-toshavim], as-all our-fathers [ka-khol avoteynu]. As-a-shadow [ke-tsel] [are] our-days upon the-earth [al ha-arets], and-there-is-no hope [eyn miqveh].

**29:16** YHWH our-God, all this abundance [ha-hamon ha-zeh] which we-have-prepared [hakhiynonu] to-build to-you a-house for-your-holy name [le-shem qodshekha] — from-your-hand [mi-yadekha] it-[is], and-to-you [is] the-all [ha-kol].

**29:17** And-I-know, my-God, that you [are] a-tester of-hearts [vocheyn levavot] and-uprightness [mesharim] you-desire [tirtzeh]. I — in-the-uprightness of-my-heart [be-yosher levavi] I-have-volunteered [hitnaddavtiy] all these [things], and-now your-people who-are-found here — I-have-seen with-joy [be-simchah] volunteering to-you.

**29:18** YHWH, God of-Avraham, Yitschaq, and-Yisra'el, our-fathers — keep [shomrah] this forever [le-olam] as-the-inclination [le-yetser] of-the-thoughts [machshevot] of-the-heart [levav] of-your-people, and-establish [ve-hakhen] their-heart [levavam] to-you [eleykha]. **29:19** And-to-Shelomoh my-son give a-whole heart [levav shalem] to-keep [lishmor] your-commandments [mitsvoteykha], your-testimonies [edvoteykha], and-your-statutes [chuqqoteykha], and-to-do [ve-la'asot] the-all [ha-kol], and-to-build the-fortress [ha-birah] which I-have-prepared [hakhiynotiy].

**29:20** And-said David to-all the-assembly: Bless [barekhhu] now YHWH your-God. And-blessed all the-assembly YHWH, God of-their-fathers, and-bowed [vayyiqqedu] and-prostrated-themselves [vayyishtachavu] to-YHWH and-to-the-king.

**29:21** And-they-sacrificed [vayyizbechu] to-YHWH sacrifices [zevachim], and-they-offered-up [vayyya'alu] burnt-offerings [olot] to-YHWH, on-the-morrow of-that day — a-thousand bulls [parim], a-thousand rams [eylim], a-thousand lambs [kevasim], and-their-drink-offerings [ve-niskeyhem], and-sacrifices in-abundance [la-rov] for-all Yisra'el.

**29:22** And-they-ate and-they-drank before YHWH on-that day with-great joy [be-simchah gedolah], and-they-made-king [vayyamlikhu] Shelomoh son of-David a-second-time [shenith], and-they-anointed [vayyimsh'chu] [him] to-YHWH as-ruler [le-nagid] and-Tsadoq as-priest [le-kohen].

**29:23** And-sat Shelomoh upon the-throne of-YHWH as-king in-place-of [tachat] David his-father, and-he-prospered [vayyatslach], and-obeyed [vayyishme'u] him all Yisra'el. **29:24** And-all the-officers [ha-sarim] and-the-mighty-men [ha-gibborim], and-also all the-sons of-David the-king, gave [natnu] a-hand [yad] under [tachat] Shelomoh the-king.

**29:25** And-made-great [vaygaddel] YHWH Shelomoh exceedingly [le-ma'lah] before-the-eyes-of [le-eyney] all Yisra'el, and-gave [vayyitten] upon-him majesty [hod] of-kingship [malkhut] which not was upon any king over Yisra'el before-him [lefanav].

**29:26** And-David son of-Yishay reigned [malakh] over all Yisra'el. **29:27** And-the-days which he-reigned over Yisra'el — forty years [arba'im shanah]: in-Chevron he-reigned seven years [sheva shanim], and-in-Yerushalayim he-reigned thirty-three [sheloshim ve-shalosh].

**29:28** And-he-died in-a-good old-age [be-seyvah tovah], satisfied [save'a] with-days [yamim], riches [osher], and-honor [kavod]. And-reigned Shelomoh his-son in-his-place [tachtav].

**29:29** And-the-deeds [divrey] of-David the-king, the-first [ha-rishonim] and-the-last [ha-acharonim] — behold, they [are] written in-the-chronicles [divrey] of-Shemu'el the-seer [ha-ro'eh], and-in-the-chronicles of-Natan the-prophet [ha-navi], and-in-the-chronicles of-Gad the-visionary [ha-chozeh]; **29:30** with all his-reign [malkhuto] and-his-might [gevurato], and-the-times [ha-ittim] that passed-over him and-over Yisra'el and-over all the-kingdoms of-the-lands [mamlakhot ha-aratsot].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — ha-birah (the-fortress):** The word *birah* is a Persian loanword meaning fortress/palace/citadel. Its use here for the temple is remarkable — the temple is a divine fortress. The same word appears in Nehemiah and Esther for the Susa citadel.

**v.5 — le-malle yado (to-fill his-hand):** The idiom "fill his hand" is the technical term for priestly consecration/ordination (cf. Exod 28:41, 29:9). David applies the priestly language of consecration to the act of giving — every donor becomes, in a sense, a priest consecrating an offering.

**v.7 — adarkonim (darics):** A Persian gold coin — an obvious anachronism if attributed to David's time, but natural for the Chronicler writing in the Persian period. The audience understood the sum in their own currency.

**v.11 — The doxology:** This verse became one of the most important liturgical texts in Judaism. The fivefold attribution — greatness, might, beauty, victory, majesty — was later adopted into Christian worship as the basis for the doxology of the Lord's Prayer ("for thine is the kingdom...").

**v.14 — ki mimm'kha ha-kol (for from-you [is] the-all):** The theological summit of 1 Chronicles: everything given to God was first given by God. Human generosity is returning what was always God's. This eliminates all pride in giving.

**v.15 — gerim ve-toshavim (sojourners and-temporary-residents):** David applies the language of landless aliens to all Israel — even the king. Before God, no one is a permanent resident. Life is a shadow (*tsel*) without substance or lasting hope (*miqveh*).

*— EMET*
